mapper.select: /* getJMA127Process */ SELECT TM_FG AS TM_FG, DECODE(TM_FG,'01','6시 이전', '02','~8시', '03','~10시', '04','~12시', '05','~13시', '06','~14시', '07','~15시', '08','~16시', '09','~17시', '10','~18시', '11','18시 이후') TM_GBN, NOW_QTY, NVL(NOW_QTY,0) - NVL(YESTER_QTY,0) NOW_RAT, ACC_NOW_QTY, NVL(ACC_NOW_QTY,0) - NVL(ACC_YESTER_QTY,0) YESTER_RAT FROM ( SELECT TM_FG, NOW_QTY, SUM(NOW_QTY) OVER (ORDER BY TM_FG RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) ACC_NOW_QTY, YESTER_QTY, SUM(YESTER_QTY) OVER (ORDER BY TM_FG RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) ACC_YESTER_QTY FROM ( SELECT LPAD(TM_FG,2,'0') TM_FG, SUM(DECODE(DT_FG,1,QTY,0)) NOW_QTY, SUM(DECODE(DT_FG,2,QTY,0)) YESTER_QTY FROM ( SELECT DT_FG, /* 1 : 상위 그리드, 2: 전일 */ FWRD_FACT_CD, /* 출하공장 */ TM_FG, /* pivot column,...1 ~ 11 */ NVL(SUM(QTY),0) QTY FROM ( SELECT FWRD_FACT_CD, DECODE(FWRD_DT,#{fwrdDt} /* 1, :FWRD_DT */,'1',TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{fwrdDt} /* 2, :FWRD_DT */,'YYYYMMDD')-1,'YYYYMMDD'),'2','3') DT_FG, MARKT.CF_FWRD_TM(FWRD_TM) TM_FG, T1.FWRD_QTY * CE_CONV_UT QTY FROM MARKT.CT_FWRD T1, COMN.AM_PROD_MSTR T2 WHERE T1.PROD_CD = T2.PROD_CD AND (SAL_FORM_CD NOT IN ('CX','TR') OR ( SAL_FORM_CD = 'TR' AND ARRV_FACT_CD > '0200') ) AND SUBSTR(SAL_FORM_CD,1,1)||TRSP_MEAN_CD NOT IN ('ES' ,'EK') AND T1.PROD_CD NOT IN ('BK077','BK027','CK395','CK396') AND FWRD_FACT_CD LIKE #{factCd} /* 3, :FACT_CD */||'%' AND FWRD_DT IN (#{fwrdDt} /* 4, :FWRD_DT */, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{fwrdDt} /* 5, :FWRD_DT */,'YYYYMMDD')-1,'YYYYMMDD')) ) TA1 GROUP BY DT_FG, FWRD_FACT_CD, TM_FG ) TA1, ( SELECT T2.SAL_UT_CD,T2.SAL_UT_NM,T1.SRT_ORD, CE_COAST_INLND_FG_CD FROM COMN.AM_SAL_UT_STRCT T1, COMN.AM_SAL_UT T2 WHERE T1.SAL_PART_CD = '01' AND T1.CE_FWRD_FACT_KND_CD IN ('1','2','3') AND T1.SAL_UT_CD = T2.SAL_UT_CD ) TA2 WHERE TA1.FWRD_FACT_CD = TA2.SAL_UT_CD GROUP BY TM_FG ) ) ORDER BY TM_FG
